; Build with ca65/ld65 using
; layout.cfg; image.nes supplies the incbin ranges. Banks are 16K UxROM banks
; 0-7; bank 7 is fixed at $C000-$FFFF, banks 0-6 appear at $8000-$BFFF.
; Each region header gives its classification, provenance and physical file
; range (including the 16-byte iNES header). Provenance "Observed" means the
; instructions were fetched in a recorded trace (some only in the artificial
; RAM-patched scenarios S13b/S14); "Static" means they are known only from
; static flow. A header inside a routine marks such a provenance split, not
; a routine boundary. Provenance "Manual" marks only the two single bytes at
; bank 3 $B6B0 and bank 4 $B685: generic data of unknown meaning, assigned by
; a user-directed fallback rather than by evidence (see their notes).
; ---- hardware registers and RAM variables ----
; 2 bytes, NMI handler address; the fixed NMI vector does jmp (NmiVector)
; last 16K bank number written by SwitchPrgBank
; player sprite frame currently in CHR-RAM $1010 (bank 3 UploadPlayerFrame)
; options menu: 0 = MUSIC (in-game tune), non-zero = EFFECTS (sound effects); 1 at power-on
; non-zero in a two-player game (player 2 lives cleared when 0)
; 2 bytes, tower number 0-7 per player (indexed by CurrentPlayer)
; 6 bytes, 24-bit binary score per player, 3 bytes each (lo, mid, hi) at $0C + 3*player
; 2 bytes, lives per player
; 0 or 1
; 3 bytes, 24-bit high score (lo, mid, hi), 5000 at power-on; updated by bank 3 UpdateHiScore
; 2 bytes, general-purpose pointer (lo/hi), also used as scratch
; 2 bytes, second general-purpose pointer
; 2 bytes, continue credits per player (set to 2 at game start, shown as CREDITS n)
; 2 bytes, per port buttons this frame: A/Select/Start edge-triggered, B and d-pad level (bit7 A ... bit0 Right)
; 8 bytes, $80,$40,...,$01 lookup filled at tower start
; 25-frame cycle counter (StepHudTimers); the second half blanks a blinking lives display
; 2 bytes, per player: frames left of the extra-life blink of the lives display
; bit 7 set by the gameplay NMI; the main loop waits for it
; $FF = attract/demo play; set by the title NMI after about 2670 idle frames (reached naturally in the round-2 attract run S12)
; difficulty from the options screen: bit 7 set = HERO, clear = NOVICE (HERO: faster timer, no continues, extra life every 10000)
; 3 bytes, tower timer digits hundreds/tens/units
; copied from TimerSpeed at tower start
; 60 ($3C) normally, 45 ($2D) when HeroMode bit 7 is set
; non-zero when the tower has been climbed
